title: The Best of Cary and Morrisville: A Location Designed for Dining, Arts and Culture

# The Best of Cary and Morrisville: A Location Designed for Dining, Arts and Culture


Tri Pointe Homes


•


October 6, 2026


Share this article


Living in the Triangle has always been about more than just being at the center of technology, education and healthcare; it’s also about being in the middle of dining, arts and culture.[The Townes at Willow Park by Tri Pointe Homes®](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/the-townes-at-willow-park) puts its residents at the intersection of two vibrant Triangle towns, with dining, shopping, arts, recreation and everyday conveniences all within easy reach.


**A Dining Scene as Diverse as the Triangle Itself**


One of the best ways to experience a community is through its food, and Cary and Morrisville offer plenty of opportunities to do just that.


Cary’s dining scene has grown into a destination of its own, with[more than 200 dining options](https://www.visitraleigh.com/plan-a-trip/cities-and-towns/cary/) ranging from locally loved restaurants to[nationally and Michelin recognized culinary destinations](https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/north-carolina/cary_2986745/restaurants) . Downtown Cary offers a particularly colorful setting for an evening out, with fun restaurants, local businesses and gathering spaces all within a walkable downtown environment.


Residents can discover everything from French-inspired breads and pastries at[La Farm Bakery](https://www.lafarmbakery.com/) to Neapolitan-style pizza at[Colletta](https://www.collettarestaurant.com/location/colletta-fenton-cary/) and a variety of international cuisines throughout Cary, like Indian food at[Saffron](https://saffroncary.com/) or Mexican food at[Mezcalito](https://mezcalitogrill.com/) .


Just next door, Morrisville brings its own global flavor to the Triangle.[The town’s diversity](https://www.niche.com/places-to-live/morrisville-wake-nc/residents/) is reflected throughout its local business community where residents can find flavors and traditions from around the world.


From authentic Indian cuisine at[Chaat Mandi](https://chaatmandinc.com/) , to Chinese favorites at[G.58](https://g58cuisine.com/) and


Italian classics at[Babymoon Cafe](https://babymooncafe.com/) , Morrisville offers a diverse dining scene with something for every palate.


Whether you’re craving a familiar favorite or looking to try something new, living at The Townes at Willow Park gives you the satisfaction of knowing that your next great meal is never far away.


**Art and Culture Around Every Corner**


The arts are another defining part of life in Cary and Morrisville, giving residents countless ways to experience creativity, history and culture!


Downtown Cary has become a destination for experiencing art and culture. The[Cary Arts Center](https://www.carync.gov/recreation-enjoyment/facilities/cary-arts-center) serves as a downtown hub for the arts, offering performances, gallery exhibits, visual and performing arts classes, studio programs and more. From[public art installations](https://www.carync.gov/recreation-enjoyment/arts-culture/public-art-galleries/public-art) to community festivals and events, like the[Lazy Daze Art Festival](https://www.carync.gov/recreation-enjoyment/events/festivals/lazy-daze-arts-and-crafts-festival) hosted every August, creativity is incorporated into the places where residents already gather and spend time. The town’s[GLOW](https://www.carync.gov/recreation-enjoyment/arts-culture/gallery-exhibitions/glow) outdoor art series, for example, has brought temporary public art installations to the town since 2021, and the[Ritmo Latino Festival](https://diamanteartsculturalcenter.org/ritmo-latino-festival/) has brought authentic Latin music, dance and culture to Cary for 22 years.


Morrisville offers its own creative experiences. The town is home to[three public murals](https://www.morrisvillenc.gov/Things-To-Do/Public-Art) designed to enhance cultural connectivity and bring art into everyday community spaces. Murals at Shiloh Park, the Morrisville Aquatics & Fitness Center and the Fire Administration Building give residents and visitors a chance to encounter local artwork while enjoying familiar places throughout town.


Morrisville’s cultural calendar reflects the diversity of the community, with events such as its annual[International Festival](https://www.morrisvillenc.gov/Events-directory/International-Festival) bringing together food, music, dance, art and cultural traditions from around the world.


For residents of The Townes at Willow Park, art and culture aren’t reserved for special occasions. They are woven into the communities surrounding home!


**More Ways to Spend Your Weekend**


Of course, a vibrant location is about more than where you eat and what you see. It’s about having plenty of ways to spend your time.


Cary offers more than[100 miles of greenways](https://www.carync.gov/recreation-enjoyment/parks-greenways-environment/greenways) connecting more than[30 public parks](https://www.carync.gov/recreation-enjoyment/parks-greenways-environment/parks) and natural areas, along with sports venues, cultural facilities and community spaces.


Morrisville offers its own collection of[parks, greenways](https://www.morrisvillenc.gov/Things-To-Do/Parks-and-Greenways) ,[recreation programs](https://www.morrisvillenc.gov/Things-To-Do/Programs-Athletics) and[community events](https://www.morrisvillenc.gov/Things-To-Do/Special-Events) giving residents even more chances to get outside and connect with neighbors. From exploring a greenway to visiting the[Western Wake Farmers’ Market](https://westernwakefarmersmarket.org/) , there are plenty of ways to make the most of a weekend all while staying close to home.


And because The Townes at Willow Park is positioned within the greater Triangle, the possibilities don’t just stop in Cary and Morrisville.[Research Triangle Park](https://www.rtp.org/) and[Raleigh-Durham International Airport](https://www.rdu.com/) are both less than 15 minutes away, while Raleigh, Chapel Hill and Durham are all within easy reach.


**Come Home to the Heart of It All**


The location is only part of what makes The Townes at Willow Park an appealing place to call home. Inside the community, residents can enjoy thoughtfully designed townhomes that give them a comfortable space for experiencing everything that the Triangle has to offer.


The Townes at Willow Park features three- and four-bedroom townhomes with approximately 2,011 to 2,449 square feet, two-bay garages and open concept floorplans. Tri Pointe Homes also incorporates[LivingSmart®](https://www.tripointehomes.com/blog/living-smarter) and[LiveAbility™](https://www.tripointehomes.com/different-by-design) approaches into the community, which focuses on features designed around comfort, wellness, and sustainability.


At The Townes at Willow Park, home puts residents within reach of two vibrant communities, each offering its own personality, experiences and ways to connect.


Cary brings its vibrant downtown, arts venues, cultural events, diverse dining and extensive parks and greenways. Morrisville adds its own global dining scene, public arts, local businesses and collection of community destinations. Together, they create a location where there is always somewhere to go, something new to taste or see and something immersive to experience!
